name: HyperFrames
description: Renders HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos, with a CLI and on-demand skills that let coding agents write, preview, and render compositions.

skills.name: HTML To MP4 Rendering
skills.description: Seeks each frame of an HTML composition in headless Chrome and encodes it with FFmpeg, so the same input always renders the same MP4.

skills.name: Creation Workflow Skills
skills.description: Routes requests through /hyperframes to workflows such as product launch videos, PR-to-video, captions, motion graphics, and slideshows.

skills.name: CLI Dev Loop
skills.description: Initializes, lints, previews with live reload, and renders compositions with the hyperframes CLI, plus HeyGen cloud and AWS Lambda renders.

skills.name: Registry Blocks
skills.description: Searches and installs reusable blocks and components into a composition with hyperframes catalog and hyperframes add before hand-building.
